Subject: Quarrow Grill Holdings - Referral Questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Quarrow Grill Holdings. I've reviewed the information and have a few questions before I can move forward.

The five-year loss history shows incurred losses exceeding $250K, which requires additional review. To help me present this to our senior underwriter, could you please provide:

- Details on the largest losses (causes, corrective actions taken)
- Any risk improvements implemented since these losses
- Current risk management practices in place

If our appetite remains limited after review, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty restaurant program, as they may have more flexibility with this loss profile.

Happy to discuss further if helpful.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
